remarks:
Nestled along the lakefront, Willow Tree Point is a warm and welcoming community offering an exceptional lifestyle without the upkeep and an abundance of amenities. Enjoy your own personal boat slip on the community docks (#26), a heated swimming pool, and a clubhouse perfect for gathering with friends and neighbors. Plus, the renowned Chautauqua Institution is located less than two miles away.

Unit #24 is ideally situated within the community—close to all the action while still providing a sense of privacy and space. Tastefully remodeled and thoughtfully designed, this move-in-ready home is ready to be enjoyed from day one. Relax or entertain on the spacious deck, perfect for outdoor dining, grilling, and lounging.

Step inside to the tiled main level featuring a new sliding patio door that fills the space with natural light. The oak kitchen offers durable solid-surface countertops and new appliances, all purchased with extended warranties for added peace of mind. A full main-level bathroom with a shower provides added convenience for family and guests.

Upstairs, engineered hardwood flooring leads to a generous primary suite with beautiful lake views. A spacious second bedroom easily accommodates family and visitors. The remodeled main bathroom showcases a tiled shower, updated backsplash, tile flooring, and granite countertops.

The finished lower level adds approximately 350 square feet of living space and serves as an excellent alternative primary suite, complete with an ensuite bathroom. A large window brings in abundant natural light, creating a bright and inviting retreat. Additional updates include new carpeting throughout, a new stackable washer and dryer, and a furnace and fireplace that have been replaced within the last four years.

Whether you're looking for a seasonal getaway or a place to create lasting memories with family and friends, this exceptional property offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lakefront living.
